summary: Mid-market SaaS vendor (product support + search) evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider. Initial plan: validate Hosted API in EU region for data-residency and latency, then move to Dedicated reserved capacity for production throughput and predictable pricing. Strong emphasis on geo-fencing (EU-only data residency) with limited multi-region fallback only for non-personal telemetry.

use_case_details: Primary: chat-based customer support assistant integrated into product UI. Secondary: document search / semantic ranking for support KB. Need embeddings for semantic search and reranking to boost precision. Expected peak: ~20 QPS chat with 3–4 concurrent long sessions; monthly tokens ~200k-600k depending on rollout. Latency SLO: p95 <= 150ms for short-turn chats; better if Dedicated (aiming p95 ~60-90ms). Cost sensitivity: mid-level — willing to commit if price / ARR predictable.
technical_requirements: EU data residency enforced for PII and all user message payloads. SSO (SAML) for console. Customer KMS for key wrapping (bring-your-own-key) preferred. Audit logs retention 2 years minimum (they asked about 7 years in initial legal, but will settle 2+). Must support model pinning and canary rollouts. Prefer open-model variants (quantized Llama-3 13B / 7B family) but flexible to Redwood-verified models for latency/cost tradeoffs.
poc_scope_and_success_metrics: Host small subset of traffic on Hosted API EU region for 2 weeks. Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency for short chats, tokens-per-dollar cost, generation quality (top-1 correctness on 50 eval prompts), embedding cosine consistency against baseline. Success = p95 <= 150ms AND embeddings within 0.02 cosine vs baseline AND cost <= target Band B.
observations_from_poc: Early Hosted EU results: p95 ~ 110-140ms on dev env for short prompts; tails hit 220ms on long-context churn. Embeddings throughput fine; cost slightly higher than customer expected for peak sustained QPS. Dedicated expected to lower tail latency and reduce unit cost but requires commit. Multi-region routing: legal wants EU-only for user messages; customer is open to multi-region for model telemetry and anonymized metrics. Concern: failover to US region acceptable only for non-PII and after legal sign-off.
pricing_notes: Shared 3-node Dedicated (reserved) estimate: 36–48k USD/yr for configuration meeting 20 QPS sustained. Hosted API per-token projection shows higher variance; customer requests a blended committed discount if they start on Hosted and convert to Dedicated within 6 months.
sales_notes: AE Priya is pushing for a staged conversion path: Hosted POC -> 3-month pilot on Dedicated (bring-up 2 reserved nodes) -> annual commitment. Customer asked for an explicit SLA on region availability (eu-west) and documentation on routing/fallback policy. Legal wants explicit guarantees that PII will not cross EU boundaries except for anonymized telemetry.
